prerequisites: Simple operations with integer arithmetic in base 2
Reasoning with elementary notions of Boolean algebra
Proficiency in C programming (pointers in particular)

learning_outcomes.text: Master the basic principles of digital design and microprocessor architecture, the notions underlying program execution (instruction interpretation, input/output management, interrupt management), and the interface between software and hardware.
Write simple C programs capable of interacting with hardware peripherals (sensors and actuators), as they can be further explored later in the design of embedded or robotic systems.

syllabus_topics: Design of simple dedicated circuits (ASIC): combinatorial circuit design and logical synthesis
Modeling of expected behavior of synchronous sequential circuits, and their logical synthesis
Basic concepts of microprocessor design (instruction decoding/execution) and software/hardware interface
Basic organization of a microprocessor (control, calculations, registers, communications)

Cooperation between hardware and software in a microprocessor at 3 interaction points: instruction set interpretation, very low-level input/output (data transfers and synchronization), interrupt mechanism management
Programming simple C applications on ARM processor and interactions with hardware peripherals
institution: Institut National Polytechnique De Grenoble — Licence Informatique (UGA)
